profile.headline: Software Developer,  State of Oregon, DCBS
profile.summary:
Currently an Application Developer in DotNet, PLSQL, ColdFusion/Javascript/HTML/CSS 

Previous Skills/Qualifications
•	Ten years’ combined professional experience as a Hardware Technician and freelance IT consultant.
•	Five years’ Computer/IT help desk experience in multi-site physician clinic with fifty plus providers supporting four hundred end users. Major responsibilities included equipment repair, software installation, and trouble shooting.
•	Ten years’ experience using Linux in a desktop and server environment.
•	Experience administering Microsoft Servers, users accounts, permissions, shares and group policies in active directory.
•	Assisted with implementation and planning of two major upgrades in a large organization.
•	Provided outstanding customer relations while managing three technicians work flows in an automotive service center.  This included intake to completion.

Accomplishments

•	Developed a database for a local physician’s office project.  Created the SQL database using their specific needs.  Developed a web interface and connected to the database using NodeJs.

•	Project manager for a non-profit relocating into their own building and using their own equipment.  This included researching technology, proposing options to the executive board.  Following authorization and funding, the recommended hardware and software was procured.  Open source software was used for budgetary reasons.  Currently configuring on-site and onboarding.

•	Currently working with a team developing a graphical user interface using C++ and QT connecting to a SQL database also using Github to collaborate.

•	Implemented electronic automotive shop management software that included job tracking for automotive service center.
